From Aqua Necklace · Price: the target must drink or breathe your stand's water or vapor.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 2 actions: your stand enters a creature that drinks your water or breathes your vapor (a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-ft burst} within 30 ft): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} for 1 minute (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 5: Surge: attack from inside: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 9: The creature can't eat or drink while infected.
  • 13: Fog area 10 ft.
  • 17: A critical failure leaves it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
